Trigger A creature hits you with a Strike

Effect You pop the emoji, creating a bright light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. Creatures in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] until the end of your next turn (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Blinded] on a critical failure).
